item.title: Pushing to main still needs a process
item.content:encoded: Direct pushes can keep development simple, but trust needs concrete checks. Look at access, traceability, tests, and recovery before copying a team's workflow.

item.title: What changes when you stop opening the code editor?
item.content:encoded: Coding agents can move work outside the editor. Understanding changes, reproducing bugs, and checking the application still need a place in the workflow.

item.title: Cloudflare Hyperdrive tutorial: use PostgreSQL with Workers
item.content:encoded: Learn Cloudflare Hyperdrive with PostgreSQL and Workers, configure pooling and caching, and see how it fits with D1, R2, Queues, Supabase, and Neon.

item.title: What teaching can tell us about prompting
item.content:encoded: Clear examples and useful feedback help when teaching a concept or directing a coding agent. Explain the expected behavior and show where the result differs.

item.title: Too many conversations with coding agents
item.content:encoded: Several coding agent chats can leave decisions scattered across sessions. Keep one place for the current task, and give parallel work a clear handoff.

item.title: Software with a point of view
item.content:encoded: A software maker's taste shows up in defaults, empty states, and ordinary interactions. Give your app character through decisions that help people use it.

item.title: What would make an overnight agent useful?
item.content:encoded: An overnight coding agent needs a question worth answering. Start with the decision its result will help you make, and keep the morning review manageable.

item.title: I care more about the AI product I can use
item.content:encoded: An impressive AI roadmap means little when the product you need is unavailable. A practical way to separate future promises from today's useful software.

item.title: How to use Cursor Computer Use
item.content:encoded: Use Cursor Computer Use to test desktop apps and iOS Simulator flows, reproduce UI bugs, and verify fixes with clear prompts and expected results.

item.title: The complete guide to LM Studio Bionic
item.content:encoded: Learn LM Studio Bionic: choose local or cloud models, fix a JavaScript bug step by step, work with documents, and review what the agent changes.

item.title: How to secure a VPS with Tailscale and Cloudflare Tunnel
item.content:encoded: Secure a VPS with private SSH over Tailscale and public web traffic through Cloudflare Tunnel. A complete guide to setup, firewalls, testing, and recovery.

item.title: What to check before submitting a native app to App Review
item.content:encoded: Prepare an Apple app for review, choose useful native interactions, adopt Liquid Glass, and understand how direct Mac distribution differs.

item.title: Triage support tickets in one request with OpenAI's Decisions API
item.content:encoded: OpenAI's Decisions API returns a probability, a choice, or a score. Triage a support ticket with several questions in one request.

item.title: How to publish a Chrome extension to the Chrome Web Store
item.content:encoded: Publish your Chrome extension with a clean ZIP, store listing, privacy disclosures, permission justifications, review instructions, and tested updates.

item.title: What to check before upgrading the Anthropic SDK
item.content:encoded: Upgrading the Anthropic SDK changes the API version your app sends. Check sampling parameters, authentication, message history, and output before you ship.

item.title: How to use a coding agent without another subscription
item.content:encoded: Connect OpenCode to DeepSeek or Ollama, understand API billing and local hardware costs, and test whether the setup works for your projects.

item.title: How to create a DMG installer for a Mac app
item.content:encoded: Package your Mac app in a drag-to-Applications DMG, sign and notarize it, verify the download, and attach it to a GitHub release.

item.title: AI video editing tools: what agents need to work safely
item.content:encoded: Recording and editing tools need inspectable state, useful commands, and recoverable changes if we want agents to help with real creative work.

item.title: A deep dive into Claude Duet
item.content:encoded: Claude Duet is Anthropic's proactive cloud agent. Learn how it works, what it can access, and how it compares with Grok Bot and ChatGPT dots.

item.title: Paid traffic for SaaS validation: how to test product demand
item.content:encoded: How to use a small paid traffic experiment to learn who gets value from a product, measure useful actions, and decide what to change.

item.title: Security in the age of AI
item.content:encoded: AI agents are finding old vulnerabilities and making complex attacks easier. A short history of automated hacking, what comes next, and how to prepare.

item.title: Give your coding agent a state machine
item.content:encoded: Build a small JavaScript state machine for a coding agent, with explicit transitions, a retry limit, a useful event log, and tests.

item.title: PSA: update PHP today
item.content:encoded: PHP security fixes are available. Update now, check the fixed versions, and use these temporary mitigations only while waiting for patched packages.

item.title: Jev vs structured outputs: when to use each
item.content:encoded: Compare Jev, JSON mode, and schema-constrained LLM outputs. Learn when a typed answer is enough and when decision probabilities justify another model.

item.title: Vite toolchain: Cloudflare, vinext, and shared web tooling
item.content:encoded: Vite is becoming shared infrastructure for frameworks, runtimes, and developer tools. What vinext, Cloudflare's new tooling, and DevTools show.

item.title: SPA vs server-side rendering: which should you choose?
item.content:encoded: Choose between a single-page app, server-rendered pages, and interactive islands by looking at navigation, shared state, loading, and maintenance.

item.title: A deep dive into tsrs
item.content:encoded: Understand tsrs, the Rust port of TypeScript. Try the compiler, compare benchmarks, explore its architecture, and build a browser-based type checker.

item.title: How to update all global npm packages
item.content:encoded: Update all global npm packages with npm update -g, check outdated tools, update one package, and understand which Node installation you are changing.

item.title: Cloudflare Pages vs Workers: which should you choose?
item.content:encoded: Compare Cloudflare Pages and Workers for static sites and full-stack apps, with request diagrams, pricing examples, and advice on when to migrate.

item.title: AI-assisted code migration: how to switch frameworks safely
item.content:encoded: Coding agents can handle repetitive migrations, but switching costs also include design drift, production behavior, deployment, and future maintenance.
